backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features (app redeployment and contact email display) to their implementing files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file describing their purpose and key implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, and UI component tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Land Share Property Claim site, loading the React app via main.tsx with favicon and meta description tags.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component composing the full single-page layout with header, hero, introduction, owners, property details, claim summary, documents, contact sections, and footer.
frontend/src/components/DocumentsSection: Renders a grid of clickable document cards from siteContent, or an empty-state placeholder with an icon when no documents exist.
frontend/src/components/PropertyDetailsS: Displays structured property records grouped by category using Cards, Badges, and collapsible Accordions for plot lists, totals, and notes.
frontend/src/components/Section.tsx: Generic reusable section wrapper that renders a titled, optionally subtitled content block with consistent padding and max-width constraints.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer component showing a disclaimer box, a clickable mailto link for khutiaashim@gmail.com, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header with the site title, smooth-scroll desktop navigation buttons, and a toggleable mobile navigation menu that reacts to scroll position.
frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and the main `siteContent` object containing all site text, navigation, and structured property data (plots, khatian references, categories) for the land claim website.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file reserving space for future React Query hooks for backend integration; currently exports nothing functional.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines an earth-tone OKLCH CSS custom property color palette for both light and dark modes, plus base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` wrappers around the root `App` component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH-based semantic color tokens, custom font families (Inter, Merriweather), border radii, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking schema version, existing features, and a pending action request to add a contact email (khutiaashim@gmail.com) to the Property Draft Site.
